messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets. Use the medicine exactly as directed. Ask your doctor or pharmacist if you don't understand how to use an injection.
Prepare an injection only when you are ready to give it. Do not use it if the medicine looks cloudy, has changed colors, or has particles in it.
Insulin glargine is injected under the skin, using a syringe or insulin pen, once per day at the same time of day.
Insulin can be injected into your upper legs (thighs), upper arms, or stomach area (abdomen). Do not inject into the same place two times in a row. Avoid injecting into skin that is damaged, tender, bruised, pitted, thickened, scaly, or has a scar or hard lump.
When treating type 1 diabetes, use your short-acting insulin before meals as directed by your doctor.
Insulin glargine must not be given with an insulin pump or mixed with other insulins. Do not inject insulin glargine into a vein or a muscle.
Triplet: ["Insulin glargine", "has injection site", "upper arms"]

The relation 'has injection site' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject medication is intended to be injected into the anatomical site specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'administered via': The subject drug is given through the route of administration specified by the object entity.
B. 'can pass into': The subject drug can transfer into the biological fluid or substance specified by the object entity.
C. 'has metabolism pathway': The subject drug is metabolized or processed through the organ or system specified by the object entity.
D. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
